joy: FYI our edge sample failed after the SDK export map change in v1.7.0. Cloudflare Worker build errors with: "Failed to resolve module specifier './dist/index.cjs.js'". repro: `wrangler dev`.

ravi: That's the exports conditionals biting us. Are we still shipping any require-only exports?

joy: Package exports section: ```json "exports": {
  ".": { "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" } }```

nina: Some edge bundlers ignore the import condition ordering and fall back to require. Also we forgot to re-export `withAuthRetry` from the ESM build, so edge sees undefined at runtime.

ci-bot: build/sample-apps #482 failing: samples/edge-worker imports -> "Cannot read property 'withAuthRetry' of undefined"

ravi: Plan: re-export helper in ESM, add a small esbuild-based test for bundling to the samples CI, and add `types` under exports for top-level resolution. Then cut 1.7.1 patch.

joy: I'll open the PR to re-export and add tests, and temporarily change the sample to import from `@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.mjs` to unblock demos.

nina: Also add a short onboarding blurb in README about export maps + edge runtimes and a minimal esbuild config.

ravi: Good. Add a changelog entry explaining the exports change and guidance for pinning older versions if needed.

joy: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1250 linked in #support for triage. ping me for review. :thumbsup:
